fragmentA:
Content Safety

By default, content that is safe and suitable for all ages is all you'll see on the site, and how most of our users browse. The default filters focus on art, so filter out things like memes and what some users would consider "spam".

Filters let you customize what content you see on the site. This means that with the appropriate filter selected, you can access content which is not suitable for everyone, such as sexually explicit, grimdark or gory material.

By changing away from the default filters, you accept you are legally permitted to view this content in your jurisdiction. If in doubt, stick with the recommended default filters.
fragmentB:
内容安全

默认情况下，您在网站上看到的内容都是适合所有年龄段的安全内容，这也是大多数用户浏览网站时采用的方式。 默认过滤器主要关注艺术作品，因此会过滤掉例如模因，以及一些用户认为属于“垃圾内容”的内容。

过滤器允许您自定义在网站上看到的内容。这意味着，通过选择合适的过滤器，您可以访问并非所有人都适合查看的内容，例如露骨色情内容、黑暗向（grimdark）内容或血腥内容。

更改默认过滤器即表示您确认，根据您所在司法管辖区的法律，您有权查看这些内容。如有疑问，请继续使用推荐的默认过滤器。
浏览过滤器

fragmentA: Images posted on the site are tagged, allowing you to easily search for content. You can also filter out content you'd rather not see using filters. Filters are sets of tags - spoilered tags and hidden tags. Spoilers are images that show up as thumbnails instead of the image, letting you click through and find out more about an image before deciding to view it or not. Hidden tags will simply hide images.
fragmentB: 网站上的图片均带有标签，方便您搜索内容。您也可以使用过滤器屏蔽您不希望看到的内容。过滤器由标签组合组成，包括“剧透”标签和“隐藏”标签。剧透标签会让图片以剧透缩略图的形式显示，而不是直接显示图片，用户可以点击进入查看，并在决定是否浏览前了解更多信息。隐藏标签会直接隐藏图片。

fragmentA: There are set of global filters to pick from which cover some common use-cases. If you're logged in you can also customize these filters and make your own, as well as quickly switch (via the menu on every page) between them.
fragmentB: 有一套全局过滤器可供选择，涵盖一些常见的使用场景。如果你已经登录，还可以自定义这些过滤器，可以自己创建，并且可以通过菜单快速切换。
这些过滤器如何工作？

fragmentA: You can select any filter you can see. This will become your active filter and will affect how you see the site. You can edit filters if you own them - you can create a filter from scratch with the link under "My Filters" (if you're logged in, of course) or by clicking "Customize", which will copy an existing filter for you to edit.
fragmentB: 您可以选择任何可见的过滤器。该过滤器将成为您的当前活动过滤器，并影响您浏览网站的方式。如果您拥有某个过滤器，则可以编辑它。——你可以从头创建过滤器，通过“我的过滤器”下的链接（当然，需要登陆），或者点击“自定义”，这样可以复制一个现有过滤器供你编辑。

fragmentA: By default all the filters you create are private and only visible by you. You can have as many as you like and switch between them instantly with no limits. You can also create a public filter, which can be seen and used by any user on the site, allowing you to share useful filters with others.
fragmentB: 默认情况下，你创建的所有过滤器都是私密的，只有你自己能看到。你可以拥有任意数量的过滤器，并且可以随时切换。你还可以创建一个公开过滤器，任何用户都能看到并使用，方便你与他人分享有用的过滤功能。

fragmentA: #2 Properly tag and source images

fragmentA: Without doubt, Derpibooru's most defining feature is our tagging system, which is what organizes the over one million images that have been posted to this website, allowing anyone to find exactly what they are looking for quickly and easily, while filtering out anything they may not want to see. Anyone can edit an image's tags to help organize it better, but it is important to keep tags consistent and accurate.
fragmentB: 毫无疑问，Derpibooru 最显著的特点是我们的标签系统，它组织了发布到本网站上的超过一百万张图片，使任何人都能快速轻松地找到他们想要的内容，同时过滤掉他们可能不想看到的内容。任何人都可以编辑图片的标签以帮助更好地组织，但保持标签的一致性和准确性非常重要。

fragmentA: • All images must have 1 or more rating tags . Note that Safe is overridden by any other.

fragmentA: If an image is not adequately tagged or sourced, please correct it yourself (when possible, report otherwise) and do not complain in a comment. If someone is consistently tagging/sourcing inadequately, report them.

fragmentA: Tags should describe the "facts" of an image, like the characters, their relationships, events happening, and the image's composition. fragmentA: Rule 0: What does apparent only purpose being to incite anger, argument, or controversy mean?

fragmentA: While many controversial or offensive things may be useful for purposes of enjoyment or argument, sometimes they are clearly posted merely to get rise out of others, and we will not tolerate this. Note that for artwork, we have no intention of removing it simply because it's controversial or provocative, as artwork really has a place in being such, but it must have value beyond merely causing anger. Images that are simply text lazily overlaid on things or that are otherwise simple edits will receive the harshest treatment, as they contain little in the way of artistic quality.

fragmentB: 规则 0："骚扰"是什么意思？

fragmentA: Calling people names, throwing out wild accusations, and casting shade in general isn't really a way to be excellent to others, and so has to be forbidden. Also, it is fine to talk about people's behavior and make reasonable accusations, but not to slander with something where there is little to no evidence.

fragmentA: "Personal characteristics" are things one has little control over being when growing up, like ethnicity, sex, sexuality, religion, or even their handedness, and we don't allow any discrimination on them. Because this is an especially troublesome area for there to be hatred in in a community based around My Little Pony, we apply strict standards to images to determine if they are advocating discrimination. Racism can be depicted in artwork, just like it has been depicted in Friendship is Magic, but the image should not appear to be a mouthpiece for it. An OC stating to the viewer that they hate a race is not okay, nor is showing characters gleefully hitting the button to kill someone due to their race. As for what is allowed, an example is image #26452, because it portrays discomfort at the very notion that the character would express such a thing.

fragmentA: Difference between AI Generated, AI Composition, and AI Assisted
fragmentB: AI 生成、AI 合成和 AI 辅助之间的区别

fragmentA:
These tags are exclusive to each other. Please check their tag details for more information, but see below for the short version:

AI Generated are images that have been created by a Machine Learning Algorithm ("AI" for short) and have little to no editing, such as for only fixing small errors or adding text. Basically, these images result from pure prompting with only minor editing (or none at all).

AI Composition are images that use AI as the primary tool to "draw the pixels", but where the composition is heavily guided by a human, via use of sketches, extensive inpainting, and editing. These images are expected to not display any AI related flaws; see [this page] for more info.

AI Assisted re images almost entirely drawn / created by a human without AI but where used AI as a small part of their creation. For example, using AI to create background elements (where the background is not the image’s focus) or adding fine or repetitive details (like a lace pattern). This tag does not apply to an artist upscaling their own work, blurred backgrounds, or other "trivial" uses. For using AI voices, check the ai voice tag.
fragmentB:
这些标签互斥。请查看其标签详情获取更多信息，但简短版本如下：

AI 生成 是由机器学习算法（简称“AI”）创建的图片，几乎没有经过编辑，例如仅修复小错误或添加文字。基本上，这些图片纯粹通过提示词生成，仅经过少量编辑（或完全没有）。

AI 合成 是使用 AI 作为“绘制像素”的主要工具，但构图由人工通过草图、大量修补和编辑来高度引导的图片。这些图片不应显示任何 AI 相关的缺陷；详情请参阅[此页面]。

AI 辅助 是指几乎完全由人工绘制/创作、未使用 AI 的图片，但使用 AI 作为创作的一小部分。例如，使用 AI 创建背景元素（背景不是图片焦点）或添加精细或重复的细节（如花边图案）。此标签不适用于艺术家放大自己的作品、模糊背景或其他“微不足道”的用途。对于使用 AI 声音，请查看 ai voice 标签。

fragmentB: 如何删除我的账户？

fragmentA: We actively monitor images and will delete any upload that violates the Site Rules, or belongs to an artist on our Do Not Post List. If you feel your upload was taken down in error, please don't re-upload it – contact us and we'll talk! We're only human and mistakes do happen.

However, old pictures from before this rule change that now break this rule are allowed to stay. Alternately, memes that have been spammed, such as the same image with a different caption uploaded again and again, will likely be deleted. If you feel an image breaks the rules report it using the "report" button found on every image page. If you feel an image was taken down in error, please contact us.

fragmentA: Uploading content is a piece of cake. You just hit the 'Upload' button and fill in the form. However, there's a few little details we'd like to explain better to you if you're interested.

元数据

fragmentA: We provide a few fields for metadata - tags are designed to let you group images together, and describe things in terms of their content. We also have a description field, which is intended mostly for people uploading original content to the site, or for more detailed description of images or context around the image. It can also be used for audio description of images for people with screenreaders.
fragmentB: 我们提供了几个元数据字段——标签旨在让您将图片分组，并根据内容描述事物。我们还有一个描述字段，主要用于向网站上传原创内容的用户，或用于更详细地描述图片或图片背景。它也可用于为使用屏幕阅读器的用户提供图片的音频描述。

fragmentA: For instance, the fact that an image contains twilight sparkle belongs as a tag, and if it's the summer sun celebration, that's a tag, too. fragmentB: 例如，图片包含 twilight sparkle 这一事实属于标签，如果是 summer sun celebration，那也是一个标签。像 Twilight sparkle standing on the steps in awe at Celestia at the Summer Sun Celebration, wide-eyed in awe 这样的完整描述应在描述字段中完成。

fragmentA: We also have some "meta" tags — artist:artist name tags should be used to link an artist name to an image. There are also spoilered or hidden by default tags, which stop NSFW things from popping up when not wanted. These should be used where appropriate.
fragmentB: 我们还有一些“元”标签——artist:artist name 标签应用于将艺术家名称链接到图片。还有一些默认被剧透或隐藏的标签，用于阻止 NSFW 内容在不需要时出现。这些应在适当时使用。

fragmentA: Finally, there is the source URL field. This should link to the page on which the image was originally found. If you don't know, leave it blank, but try to find it first.
fragmentB: 最后，还有来源 URL 字段。这应链接到最初找到图片的页面。如果您不知道，请留空，但请先尝试找到它。

fragmentA: Derpibooru disallows purely AI generated content (created via a prompt with little or no editing), but does permit AI Compositions (images with clear direction and editing from an artist), as well as the use of AI for simple edits and elements (blurry backgrounds, cleanup, detailing, audio).
fragmentB: Derpibooru 不允许纯 AI 生成的内容（通过提示词生成且几乎没有编辑），但允许 AI 合成（由艺术家提供明确指导和编辑的图片），以及使用 AI 进行简单编辑和元素处理（模糊背景、清理、细化、音频）。

fragmentA: Those interested in AI content in general are encouraged to visit Tantabus, an imageboard dedicated to MLP related AI content.
fragmentB: 对 AI 内容感兴趣的用户，建议访问 Tantabus，这是一个专门收录 MLP 相关 AI 内容的图片板。

fragmentB: 我们支持 SVG 上传——一旦服务器接收到，我们会将其转换为 PNG 图片，但用户仍然可以在图片的链接中下载和查看 SVG 版本。我们使用 librsvg 来渲染图片。

fragmentA: When you upload a GIF, JPEG or PNG, we do some checks on the image once it's been uploaded. Most images have un-needed data in them, which can be safely removed without affecting quality. fragmentB: 当您上传 GIF、JPEG 或 PNG 时，我们会在图片上传后对其进行一些检查。大多数图片中包含不必要的数据，这些数据可以安全地删除而不影响质量。我们使用一些工具对您的上传进行处理，从而减少存储的文件大小，并加快每个人的页面加载速度。
PNG

fragmentA: We use optipng to deinterlace and compress PNG images, fixing any encoding issues on the way.
fragmentB: 我们使用 optipng 对 PNG 图片进行去隔行和压缩，同时修复任何编码问题。
JPEG

fragmentA: We use jpegtran to sort out JPEGs, which supports lossless optimization of the entropy encoding scheme used in JPEG compression.
fragmentB: 我们使用 jpegtran 处理 JPEG，它支持对 JPEG 压缩中使用的熵编码方案进行无损优化。
GIF

fragmentB: GIF 稍微复杂一些，因为我们将所有 GIF 视为可能是动画，因此必须处理所有帧。我们使用 gifsicle 和 ffmpeg 来处理 GIF。
SVG

fragmentA: SVG images are left unchanged by uploads.
fragmentB: SVG 图片在上传后保持不变。

fragmentB: 我们使用基于简单图像强度的机制进行感知图片去重，多年来该机制已被证明具有可扩展性和相当可靠性。我们还在网站上提供图片的 SHA512 哈希值，尽管这些哈希值已不再内部用于去重。

fragmentB: 我们在后台完成所有处理，在处理过程中，我们继续提供未优化的文件，因此对任何人来说都没有明显差异。但值得注意的是，如果您打算下载文件，您可能希望等待完全处理后的图片可用。

fragmentA: Content is uploaded to Derpibooru by users of the site to share artwork they have discovered with the community. Broadly speaking, someone uploaded your artwork because they thought it was worth sharing!

fragmentA: How do I stop people uploading my art in future?
fragmentB: 如何阻止他人将来上传我的艺术作品？

fragmentA: If you're finding your artwork being posted here and do not want it to be posted to the site, yet find people still appear to feel entitled to do so, check which license you have licensed your artwork under, particularly on sites like deviantART. If your license explicitly permits reuse and redistribution, you are likely to find people sharing it - as the license makes it clear they are allowed to.
fragmentB: 如果您发现您的艺术作品被发布在这里而您不希望它被发布到网站上，但仍有人似乎觉得有权这样做，请检查您使用的许可证，尤其是在 deviantART 等网站上。如果您的许可证明确允许重用和再分发，您很可能会发现有人在分享它——因为许可证明确允许他们这样做。

fragmentA: In these cases, switching to a more restrictive license may be the best way of stopping your content being shared on the site and others like it. We do have a do-not-post list, which is a last resort for artists who do not wish their content to be shared on the site; you can view the list and request to be added here.
fragmentB: 在这种情况下，切换到限制性更强的许可证可能是阻止您的内容在此网站及类似网站上被分享的最佳方式。我们确实有禁止发布列表，这是不希望其内容在网站上分享的艺术家的最后手段；您可以 在此处 查看列表并请求添加。

fragmentA: As the uploader of an image, you may request the image be removed; we review these cases individually, but do not guarantee that we will remove the image. If an artist has requested that you ask the image be removed, please provide their contact details so that we can verify this.

委托人的权利

fragmentA: We often receive takedown requests from the commissioners of artworks. In general, we cannot remove an artwork at the commissioners' request. The artist that was commissioned retains the copyright to an artwork, and so must be the one making a copyright based takedown request.
fragmentB: 我们经常收到来自艺术作品委托人的删除请求。一般来说，我们不能应委托人的请求移除艺术作品。被委托的艺术家保留艺术作品的版权，因此必须是提出基于版权的删除请求的一方。

fragmentA: If you agreed to transfer copyright when commissioning the artwork (which must take the form of a written agreement), you may provide us with evidence of this; we will need to contact the artist and yourself to verify that copyright was indeed transferred.
fragmentB: 如果您在委托艺术作品时同意转让版权（必须以书面协议形式），您可以向我们提供相关证据；我们需要联系艺术家和您本人来核实版权确实已被转让。
原创角色

fragmentA: Characters and character designs are not themselves subject to copyright, but instead could fall under trademark law as a protected mark if they are registered and used. This is not the case with any non-commercial characters, and so neither trademark nor copyright law lends protection to creators of "original characters" and their designs.
fragmentB: 角色和角色设计本身不受版权保护，但如果它们被注册和使用，则可能作为受保护标志属于商标法范畴。非商业角色并非如此，因此商标法和版权法都不为“原创角色”及其设计的创作者提供保护。

fragmentA: This is distinct, of course, from artworks such as reference drawings and other original artworks, which are covered by copyright if they were created by the original characters' creator - that is, artworks by other artists featuring an original character do not fall under or violate the original artists' copyright.
fragmentB: 这当然不同于参考图和其他原创艺术作品等，后者如果由原创角色的创作者创作则受版权保护——也就是说，其他艺术家创作的包含原创角色的艺术作品不属于或侵犯原创艺术家的版权。

fragmentA: Derivative works (that is, works that are non-transformative in a copyright sense) are of course still protected under copyright law; in this case an original characters' creator may file a takedown request. For instance, original artworks that feature an original character are generally transformative and so stand alone; very basic edits, on the other hand, are generally derivative.
fragmentB: 衍生作品（即在版权意义上非转换性的作品）当然仍受版权法保护；在这种情况下，原创角色的创作者可以提出删除请求。例如，以原创角色为特色的原创艺术作品通常具有转换性，因此是独立作品；而非常基础的编辑通常是衍生作品。
